item.title: HOPPERS Review: Pixar Hops To New Heights With Wit, Wonder, And A Robotic Beaver
item.description: Hoppers bounds into theaters this weekend, and Pixar is back on top form with a movie that's bursting with heart, humour, and a feel-good message that makes this one of the studio's best.

item.title: SCARY MOVIE 6 Official Trailer Comes With A Warning: "There Are No Safe Spaces"
item.description: The first trailer for horror parody "rebooquel" Scary Movie 6 has now been officially released online, and the easily offended should steer well clear!

item.title: SONIC THE HEDGEHOG 4 Officially Begins Filming As Director Jeff Fowler Wields Amy Rose's Hammer In BTS Photo
item.description: Sonic the Hedgehog 4 director Jeff Fowler has confirmed that production has started on the movie, sharing a photo of Amy Rose's iconic hammer following her debut in the last movie's stinger.

item.title: Speculation Mounts That James Gunn Could Leave DC Studios In The Wake Of WBD/Paramount Deal
item.description: Several insiders believe that DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn will ultimately decide to part ways with the company following the Warner Bros. Discovery/Paramount merger...

item.title: SPIDER-NOIR Posters Reveal First Look At Silvermane, Sandman And Electro's Powers, And A Mystery Villain
item.description: New poster art for Spider-Noir reveals Brendan Gleeson's Silverman, along with a powered-up Sandman and Electro, and another mystery villain played by Atlas star Abraham Popoola.

item.title: HOPPERS' Rotten Tomatoes Score Revealed - Is Pixar Back To Its Winning Ways?
item.description: The first reviews are in for Pixar's Hoppers, and with that comes an all-important Rotten Tomatoes score. Is the Disney-owned studio back on top form? You can learn more here.

item.title: STAR WARS: STARFIGHTER Star Ryan Gosling Reveals Why He Joined The Iconic Franchise
item.description: Following years of persistent Ghost Rider rumours, Ryan Gosling is heading into a Galaxy Far, Far Away this summer with Star Wars: Starfighter. Now, the actor has revealed why he's joined the franchise.

item.title: PIRATES OF THE CARIBBEAN Producer Says Johnny Depp WILL Return - If He Has His Way
item.description: Pirates of the Caribbean producer Jerry Bruckheimer has confirmed that Johnny Depp will return as Captain Jack Sparrow for the next movie, "if it's up to me," that is.
